Class StrayPieces

java.lang.Object
com.hypixel.hytale.component.system.System<com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.world.storage.EntityStore>
com.hypixel.hytale.component.system.RefSystem<com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.world.storage.EntityStore>
com.atomictempest.holograms.api.StrayPieces
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.hypixel.hytale.component.system.ISystem<com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.world.storage.EntityStore>, com.hypixel.hytale.component.system.QuerySystem<com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.world.storage.EntityStore>
public final class StrayPieces extends com.hypixel.hytale.component.system.RefSystem<com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.world.storage.EntityStore>
Takes away pieces that come back by themselves. An entity put in, or moved into, a chunk section that is not ticking is set aside by the game and added again when the section wakes up, and the game does this even for entities that are never saved. By then the engine has made a new one, so the old one would hang there beside it until its vanishing time. Every piece is marked, and a marked entity that is loaded instead of spawned is such a stray.
